class.name: OpenWorldTreeSpecies
class.brief_description: Library of baked variations belonging to one tree species.
class.description: [OpenWorldTreeSpecies] groups [OpenWorldTreeVariant] resources that share the same visual and gameplay identity. [method get_variant_index_for_seed] provides deterministic variation selection for placement records that do not explicitly select a variant.

method.name: get_variant_count
method.description: Returns the number of valid variations in this species.

method.name: get_variant_index_for_seed
method.description: Returns a deterministic variation index for [param seed], or [code]-1[/code] when no variations exist.

members.member: Stable species identifier used by gameplay and save data.
Optional semantic tags such as biome, climate, or wood category.
Baked visual variations available to this species.
